meta.analysis: First generation. Error direction at late layers promotes letter-combination tokens (ABC, AD) — a letter-selection/positional bias toward A/early letters (confidently wrong items mostly pick A). Helpful heads L25h9, L21h1 carry answer info; harmful head L23h7 and harmful L25/L27 neurons push wrong letters. Hypotheses: (1) remove err:final direction from late writers (L27 down, L25 o); (2) ablate harmful neurons; (3) amplify helpful heads; (4) dampen L23h7. Mix conservative and bold edits.
